items.title: Merck (MRK) Posts First Positive Phase 3 Result For Personalized mRNA Melanoma Therapy
items.summary: Merck (NYSE:MRK) and Moderna report the first positive Phase 3 results for an individualized mRNA neoantigen cancer therapy in melanoma patients. The therapy was tested in combination with Merck's immunotherapy KEYTRUDA in a Phase 3 trial setting. This marks the first time an mRNA-based individualized neoantigen approach has shown clinically meaningful and statistically significant Phase 3 data in cancer. items.title: What Do Moderna (MRNA) FDA Vaccine Approvals Mean For Its Respiratory Push?
items.summary: Moderna (NasdaqGS:MRNA) received FDA approval for updated Spikevax and mNEXSPIKE COVID-19 vaccines tailored to the latest SARS-CoV-2 subvariant. The FDA also cleared mFlusiva, Moderna's first mRNA based influenza vaccine for adults aged 50 and over. These approvals expand Moderna's respiratory vaccine portfolio and mark the first FDA authorized mRNA flu shot for older adults.
